title: Pharmacy Counter Schedule — Kestrel Care Rewards Points on Prescriptions and Vaccinations
content:
Under **Kestrel Care Rewards**, a prescription fill earns points when the patient picks it up, a vaccine dose earns points when it is given, and point-earning prescription fills also build toward a Kestrel Cash milestone reward.

## Schedule by level

| | Member | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Plus Monthly | Plus Annual |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Points per eligible prescription fill picked up | 50 | 75 | 100 | 150 | 100 | 100 |
| Most prescription points in any rolling 365 days | 5000 | 7500 | 10000 | 15000 | 10000 | 10000 |
| Point-earning fills per milestone reward | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Kestrel Cash per milestone reward (USD) | 5.00 | 5.00 | 5.00 | 7.50 | 5.00 | 5.00 |
| Points per eligible vaccine dose given | 250 | 300 | 400 | 500 | 500 | 500 |
| Most vaccination points in any rolling 365 days | 1000 | 1200 | 1600 | 2000 | 2000 | 2000 |

The columns are the levels Kestrel Care Rewards Member, Kestrel Care Rewards Silver, Kestrel Care Rewards Gold, Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum, Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly and Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual.

## Terms

**1. Fills and doses.** A prescription fill earns the level's points per fill when it is picked up, and a vaccine dose earns the level's points per dose when it is given.

**2. Fills and doses that earn nothing.** Neither a fill nor a dose earns anything when any one of the following holds:

- it was dispensed at a store located in one of these states or territories: **AL, AR, MS, NJ, NY, OR, PR**;
- it was billed to a coverage class, among the plan classes of Prescription Insurance on File, that does not allow rewards points on prescriptions billed to it;
- a savings program, among the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs, that does not allow rewards points on fills paid with its help paid part of it.

**3. Caps.** Prescription points stop at the level's prescription cap, and vaccination points stop at the level's vaccination cap. Each cap is measured over a rolling 365 calendar days ending on, and including, the current day, and counts the prescription points (or vaccination points) earned in that window that have not been reversed.

**4. Milestone reward.** Every 10 point-earning fills (the level's milestone count) issue the level's milestone reward in Kestrel Cash. The fills counted are the prescription fills that earned points and were not reversed, since the most recent milestone reward was issued or, where none has been issued, since enrollment.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical cases on an active membership)

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| A Kestrel Care Rewards Gold member picks up a fill dispensed at a store in Ohio, billed to a plan class that allows rewards points, with no savings program paying part of it | 100 points |
| The same fill dispensed at a store in New Jersey (NJ) | no points |
| A Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum member picks up a fill that a savings program not allowing rewards points on its fills paid part of | no points |
| A member at Kestrel Care Rewards Member already has 5000 unreversed prescription points in the rolling 365 days and picks up another eligible fill | no prescription points — the 5000 cap is reached |
| A Kestrel Care Rewards Gold member receives a fifth eligible vaccine dose while 1600 unreversed vaccination points already stand in the rolling 365 days | no vaccination points — the 1600 cap is reached |

**Milestone, hypothetical count.** A Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum member has 9 point-earning, unreversed fills since the last milestone reward. The next fill that earns points is the 10th, and 7.50 of Kestrel Cash is issued; counting then starts again from that reward. At Kestrel Care Rewards Silver the same 10th fill issues 5.00.

**A fill that earned no points** — for example one dispensed in an excluded state — is not a point-earning fill and does not count toward the milestone.
